title: Add a drone by chat with its model and version
goal: Adding a drone with "modello <model>, v. <version>" records the model or asks once whether to create it, never asks for a part category
acceptance: A committed test fails first: "aggiungi il drone X, modello M, v. 5.1" and its English form record the drone with model "M v5.1" (frame or drone_models link) or ask once whether to create the model
Answering the follow-up never loops back to the category question
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 when opened: phrase parsing for model and version and the follow-up answer, with failing-first tests. Not a measurement.
